feature-list.feature: 新增 4K 屏幕分辨率切换（设置 → 显示 → 屏幕分辨率）：支持在“高分辨率 (1096 x 2560, 420 dpi)”与“完整分辨率 (1644 x 3840, 630 dpi)”间无缝切换，UI 缩放比例自动同步且保留原厂亮度曲线
新增 Sony XQZ-IV01（Vlog 监视器）实机兼容：修复摄影大师（Photo Pro）与视频大师（Video Pro）外接监视器能力判定，支持 USB 授权后自动唤醒 DisplayPort 1280×720@60Hz 外屏取景、电量/状态显示与音频通道
增强 OTA 更新中心（UpdateCenter）：支持中/英双语功能介绍自动匹配，并新增 baseVersion 基线版本链强校验与 Recovery 双重防跨版本跳级保护

operator-feature-list.feature: 4K Screen Resolution Switch (Settings → Display → Screen resolution): Seamlessly switch between High resolution (1096 x 2560, 420 dpi) and Full resolution (1644 x 3840, 630 dpi) with automatic UI density scaling and stock brightness curves

Sony XQZ-IV01 Vlog Monitor Compatibility: Fixed selfie accessory capability detection in Photography Pro and Videography Pro, enabling automatic DisplayPort 1280×720@60Hz wake-up, live viewfinder, battery/status OSD, and audio level meters over USB-C

Enhanced UpdateCenter & Incremental OTA Safety: Added English/Chinese localized release notes support and strict baseVersion chain verification (client + recovery) to prevent older builds from skipping intermediate updates
